content:
Ivy: drafting a compact sync. pushing updated hero variants + inbound routing for hosted/dedicated/private. want quick thumbs.
Ivy: landing goal = one claim, one benefit, one CTA. reduce options to avoid choice paralysis.
Theo: paste the variants?
Ivy: Hosted-v1: 'Ship LLM features without ops debt.'
Ivy: Hosted-v2: 'Hosted inference with predictable latency and cost.'
Ivy: Dedicated-v1: 'SLA-backed GPU capacity for production traffic.'
Ivy: Dedicated-v2: 'Reserved pools that keep latency steady.'
Ivy: Private-v1: 'Run inference inside your VPC — audit-ready.'
Ivy: Private-v2: 'On-prem inference with enterprise controls.'
Priya: tone note: v1s feel punchier; v2s more product-y. prefer punchier for hero + v2 in subhead.
Marcus: inbound routing proposal: map to different funnels and add lead_score.
Marcus: high-level mapping:
Marcus: - Hosted -> self-serve activation (signup + quickstart)
Marcus: - Dedicated -> contact-sales (SLA interest)
Marcus: - Private -> book-security-demo (compliance packet)
Sam: adding lead scoring rules: signup = lead_score 10, contact-sales = lead_score 40, book-demo = lead_score 60. include hidden form field: product_interest=(hosted|dedicated|private).
Ivy: here's the actual form config snippet to hand to webops:
Ivy: ```
/landing/hosted -> form:signup, hidden:product_interest=hosted, tag=utm_campaign:landing_launch_hosted, lead_score=10
/landing/dedicated -> form:contact_sales, hidden:product_interest=dedicated, tag=utm_campaign:landing_launch_dedicated, lead_score=40, field:sla_checkbox=true
/landing/private -> action:book_demo, hidden:product_interest=private, tag=utm_campaign:landing_launch_private, lead_score=60, attach:security_packet.pdf
```
Priya: webinar landing note: reuse Hosted hero in header but change CTA to 'Register' and add a pre-filled question field: 'what's your throughput target?'
Theo: benchmark narrative for webinar + hero: we can say "typical production apps see 20-40% lower token latency vs baseline" but legal needs precise phrasing. will mark as claim needing data.
Ivy: draft benchmark blurb for the page (to be vetted): 'Real-world workloads saw 20-40% latency reduction and up to 3x cost savings from batching and KV caching.' flagging legal.
Marcus: for SEO, include keyword variants: "hosted inference", "dedicated inference", "private inference" in H2s and meta description.
Sam: microcopy suggestions:
Sam: - CTA canonical text: Hosted = 'Start free trial', Dedicated = 'Contact sales', Private = 'Request security demo'
Sam: - small footer note: 'Enterprise plans include extended retention, audit logs, and SSO.'
Priya: legal + product constraint: cannot promise exact cost savings on the page. swap with 'customers have reported' and link to benchmark report.
Ivy: updated hero for Hosted A/B test: A: 'Ship LLM features without ops debt.' B: 'Low-latency, cost-predictable hosted inference.' test run = 14 days, traffic split 50/50.
Theo: tracking: add hidden utm_medium=web and utm_source=organic for hero CTAs by default.
Marcus: lead routing extras: if lead_score >=50 AND product_interest=private, auto-assign to AE_team=SecuritySales.
